name: Trapmaster Tok's Surprise (3-4)
source: Pathfinder Society Quest #10: The Broken Scales
description: Pressure sensitive panels in the floor connect to a barrel of debris hidden in the hallway's ceiling
disable: DC 23 Thievery (trained) on the floor panels before the barrel falls

generalAbilities.name: Falling Debris
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger Pressure is placed on any floor tile

Effect The barrel of debris tips over and showers broken glass down. The glass deals 3d8 Slashing Damage damage and 2 Bleed Damage damage(Basic DC 22 Reflex Saving Throw save) to all creatures within 10 feet.
